text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I fell completely short! To think the gap 
was this big... jeez...!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Spring Shield goes to Mejiro Ryan! She 
showed the true grit of the Mejiro family!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Lady Ryan! Everyone in the 
Mejiro family must be so proud!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ah... with her whole body radiating joy, 
Ryan-san's first words were—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen isn't the only one in the Mejiro 
family! I'll make sure to show everyone 
that Mejiro Ryan is here too, at the 
Takarazuka Kinen as well!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Thank you all for your continued support!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(If I were in Ryan-chan's shoes, I'm sure 
I would've screamed, "I did it!")

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, Ryan-chan... prioritized the 
fans who supported her over her own 
victory.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...That is what an Umamusume who carries 
expectations looks like. The difference 
between me and Ryan-chan...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I've decided. In the Takarazuka Kinen, 
I'll...!
